about_the_game:
A glimpse into a big, magical journey

Experience a part of chapter 3 of Simon's newest adventure in this demo.

To gain more information on the ancient prophecy, Simon needs access to the magical academy. Of course, just waltzing in would be too easy; a grim-looking troll bars entry for anyone but the academy's students. Follow Simon on a trip around town and meet some of Simon the Sorcerer Origins' enchanting cast of characters, including a mysterious curiosity shop owner, a fellow student sorcerer in distress, and Chippy the dog!

Download the demo, help Simon find a way to get around the towering troll, and gain entry to the elusive academy of magic!
